The HimDairy Promise

From our own farm in Palampur, Kangra at 4,000ft — every product reaches your home within 24 hours of milking. No compromise, no chemicals, no middlemen.

Order Now
01
100% Chemical Free
Our cows eat only natural grass and fodder on our 4,000ft Palampur farm. Zero hormones, zero antibiotics, zero artificial feed — ever.
02
24-Hour Freshness Guarantee
Milk is collected, pasteurised, and dispatched from our farm within hours. Reaches your doorstep within 24 hours of milking.
03
One Farm. Full Transparency.
Every drop of milk, every spoon of ghee, every block of paneer comes from our single HimDairy farm in Palampur. You know exactly where your food comes from.
04
Traditional Bilona Ghee
Our desi ghee is made using the ancient bilona method — curd is hand-churned, butter slowly cooked on low flame. No shortcuts. Pure golden ghee the way it was always meant to be.

Did You Know?

🏔️
Altitude Makes Better Milk
Cows grazing at 4,000ft on natural Himalayan grass produce milk richer in Omega-3s, CLA, and fat-soluble vitamins.
🧬
A2 is Easier to Digest
A2 beta-casein breaks down more gently in the gut. Many people who feel uncomfortable with regular milk find A2 milk completely fine.
🫙
Bilona Ghee is Different
Industrial ghee is made from cream. Bilona ghee starts from curd — hand-churned into butter, then slow-cooked. Retains butyric acid, vitamins A, D, E, K.
🌿
Chemical-Free Means More
No synthetic fertilisers, pesticides, or chemical feed. The cows eat what the hills grow naturally — that purity passes directly into your milk.

Our Story

Born in Palampur,
Made for Your Table

Ajay and Anjali noticed something that bothered them — people were paying premium prices for "organic" dairy, but getting products full of chemicals, adulterants, and false promises. The real thing wasn't reaching anyone.

So they built their own farm in Palampur, Kangra at 4,000ft. No middlemen. No cold storage chains. Just their cows, their land, and a direct bridge to your doorstep. HimDairy is run by Ajay and Anjali themselves — personally.

"Hamari gaay ghaans khati hai, chemicals nahi. Yahi farak hai."— Ajay & Anjali · HimDairy Farm · Palampur, Kangra · 4,000ft

Every product carries the name of our farm and its altitude. Because transparency is not a marketing word for us — it's a promise.
